name: The Lost Apartment
storyline:
The story begins with the investigator going into a small apartment to explore the crime scene. After a series of terrifying events, the investigator is able to "escape" the first apartment. That's where everything takes a turn. A humanoid figure appears behind him in the hallway of the apartment block. In a desperate attempt to escape, the investigator starts running, but trips and get captured by the figure. (This part of the story is showcased in TheLostApartment Demo).

The player then wakes up in a small room, with a design similar to the one of the apartment he previously explored, with no memory of the events that occurred. Wounded and confused, Jeremy tries to find answers. Searching the room he's in, simply leaves him with more questions. As he progresses deeper into the apartment he's now trapped in, Jeremy starts to lose hope. Then, he finds letters between different people. They all share one thing. They know he's trapped here and do not want him out.
summary: 'The Lost Apartment' is a photo-realistic bodycam story horror game developed by SDevScares and published on itchio in 2025. The game has around 45-60+ minutes of playtime, featuring an intense horror experience inside an apartment.
